description_en: Queries a list of normalization rule versions
description_zh: 获取标准化规则版本列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-normalization-rule-versions --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --normalization-rule-id nr-z0b2ssjteut85uoh9nzp --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNormalizationRuleVersions

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management Center for threat analysis is located. Select the region for the Management Center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response messages. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of this member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The ID of the normalization rule
parameters.name: normalization_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for the current request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. If a next page exists, set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned on each page

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the NextToken parameter is empty, no more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
